001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004
005/**
006 * Indicates a permanent external system failure (notification class A in the exception policy):
007 * failures where the remedy requires administrator intervention.
008 *
009 * <p>This exception is used for failures from external systems that require administrator attention
010 * to resolve. Examples include:
011 *
012 * <ul>
013 *   <li>External API permanent shutdown or removal
014 *   <li>Authentication failure to external system
015 *   <li>Configuration error preventing communication with external system
016 *   <li>External system returning an error that will not resolve on its own
017 * </ul>
018 *
019 * <p>The default user-facing message advises the user to contact an administrator:
020 *
021 * <pre>{@code
022 * "システムエラーが発生しました。管理者にお問い合わせください。"
023 * }</pre>
024 *
025 * <p>Extends {@link ExternalSystemException}, and therefore {@link StreamProcessingException} and
026 * {@link IOException}, so that callers of {@link
027 * com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can handle all stream-level failures with a
028 * single {@code catch (IOException)} block.
029 *
030 * <p>See docs/reference/EXCEPTION_POLICY.md for the full exception classification policy.
031 *
032 * @see ExternalSystemException
033 * @see ExternalTransientException
034 */
035public final class ExternalPermanentException extends ExternalSystemException {
036  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
037
038  /**
039   * Default user-facing message for permanent external failures. Advises users to contact an
040   * administrator.
041   */
042  public static final String DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE = "システムエラーが発生しました。管理者にお問い合わせください。";
043
044  /**
045   * Constructs a new ExternalPermanentException with the specified detail message.
046   *
047   * @param message the detail message (developer-facing, for logging)
048   */
049  public ExternalPermanentException(String message) {
050    super(message);
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Constructs a new ExternalPermanentException with the specified detail message and cause.
055   *
056   * @param message the detail message (developer-facing, for logging)
057   * @param cause the underlying cause
058   */
059  public ExternalPermanentException(String message, Throwable cause) {
060    super(message, cause);
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Constructs a new ExternalPermanentException with the specified cause.
065   *
066   * @param cause the underlying cause
067   */
068  public ExternalPermanentException(Throwable cause) {
069    super(cause);
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Returns the default user-facing message for permanent external failures.
074   *
075   * <p>This message is suitable for display to end users, advising them to contact an
076   * administrator.
077   *
078   * @return the default permanent failure message
079   */
080  @Override
081  public String getUserMessage() {
082    return DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE;
083  }
084}
